specification.problem: Grover search on 4 qubits (N=16) with one marked basis state w, as an ideal gate-level unitary, with an optional second-neighbour ZZ phase error layer as a stand-in for the nuclear-spin-chain Ising couplings.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Ideal Grover algorithm on 4 qubits (k=3 iterations), plus an optional ZZ_{j,j+2} phase layer after each gate or iteration. The pulse-level Hamiltonian model, the Rabi-frequency scan and the 2πk-condition maxima are outside this scope. No query complexity is claimed.

symbols.domain: integer in 0..15, assumed instance w=5 unless specified

symbols.meaning: bit j of x, qubit q_j
fidelity with the target state after step t

equations.label: Uniform initial state
equations.description: Initial state; q0 is the least significant bit.
equations.justification: Standard Grover initialisation. The predicted eq. 7 is the same state and is kept in this form.

equations.label: Oracle and diffusion
equations.description: Phase oracle and inversion about the mean; one Grover iteration.
equations.justification: Standard Grover search. The abstract names the algorithm but not the equations.
assumptions: Oracle compiled from the explicit w

equations.label: Gate decomposition
equations.description: X^{\bar w} applies X to the qubits where w has a 0 bit. The diffusion equals D up to a global phase of -1.

equations.label: Iteration count and success probability
equations.description: Exact for ideal gates; the number 0.961 is evaluated at N=16, k=3.
equations.justification: Standard Grover analysis. The sketch gives the same figures.

equations.label: Fidelity and optional ZZ error layer
equations.description: The fidelity is tracked after each Grover step. E_phi is an optional second-neighbour ZZ layer, applied after each G.
equations.justification: The abstract mentions fidelity and second-nearest-neighbour Ising interactions. The error layer is a proposed simplification, not the paper's model.
assumptions: The error is modelled as a pure ZZ phase layer
The phi value is a free parameter

registers.name: q
registers.role: spin-chain qubits q0..q3; q0 is the least significant bit; all are data qubits, no ancillas

steps.description: Apply H to all 4 qubits to prepare |s>.
Repeat k=3 times: apply O_w, then D, then optionally E_phi (phi=0 by default).
Optionally record F_t after each iteration from the simulated state.

specification.measurement: Measure all qubits in the computational basis and read x=sum x_j 2^j. The circuit itself is measurement-free; measurement is applied outside it.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Output x as the candidate marked element w; success probability is about 0.961 for phi=0.
assumptions: Marked state w is an explicit instance parameter, assumed w=5 (binary 0101) unless specified
The Hamiltonian-level pulse model is not reproduced
n=4 matches the abstract's four-spin simulation
missing_information: Actual spin-chain Hamiltonian parameters and coupling values
The Rabi-frequency scan and the 2πk-condition details
The marked state used in the paper
